name: yacchi home Multi-functional Wine Bar Cabinet Bakers Rack
description: Multi-functional kitchen bakers rack and wine bar cabinet featuring a smart LED light strip and built-in power outlets (2 USB ports & 2 AC outlets). Designed with 6 spacious storage levels, a 4-tier wine rack holding up to 24 bottles, hanging glass holders, and removable S-shaped hooks. Sturdy dark wood boards with a reinforced black metal frame. Perfect for a coffee bar, liquor storage, or kitchen organizer. Selling cheap for a graduation yard sale! Note: Appliances and bottles shown in the photo are not included.
name_zh: yacchi home 多功能带插座LED咖啡吧台置物架
description_zh: 多功能厨房置物架/置物架/酒吧柜，自带智能RGB LED灯带和内置电源插座（2个USB接口+2个三插插座）。拥有6层超大储物空间，包含可放24瓶红酒的4层酒架、高脚杯吊架以及可自由组合的S型挂钩。深色木纹板搭配黑色加固铁框，非常适合用作咖啡机操作台、酒水收纳或厨房微波炉架。毕业搬家超级低价出！（照片中的咖啡机、瓶罐等非卖品不包含在内）
